## Before you run this

• **Safe to try:** Optional: add your free Gemini key to see AI openers. Stays on your computer as an environment variable, never stored or tracked.
• **No key? No problem:** Leave it out and just click 'Test workflow'. The pipeline uses clear template openers to show how it works.
• **What is sent where:** Only contacts Google News (public headlines) and Gemini API (headline text). Nothing is sent to anyone else.

## 1. Detect Stage
Manual and weekly schedule triggers. Queries 5 UAE-targeted signal feeds via Google News RSS.

## 2. Clean & Score Stage
Filters noise, verifies UAE geography, extracts entity names via regex, and scores urgency (weight x freshness + multi-signal bonus).

## 3. Prepare Stage
Generates UAE-appropriate openers (<= 45 words) using Google Gemini. Automatically falls back to template openers if Gemini is unset.

## 4. CRM Stage
Always-on export to CSV. Optional Google Sheets node (disabled by default) requires no Google account.

## 5. Reply Management Stage
Webhook receives prospect replies. Classifies intent (interested, not_now, etc.) and drafts next steps using Gemini 2.5 Flash with automatic rule-based fallback.

## Operational Safety
Drafts only. A person reviews every message. No real prospects contacted. The workflow never sends anything automatically.
